extensionDescription.message: Generates alt texts (image descriptions) for Mastodon with AI (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini or OpenRouter).
extensionDescription.description: Description of the extension shown in the add-ons manager.

actionTitle.description: Tooltip of the toolbar button, which opens the settings.

buttonGenerate.description: Button in Mastodon's alt-text dialog that generates the image description.

buttonGenerateTitle.description: Tooltip of the generate button in Mastodon's alt-text dialog.

buttonGenerating.description: Label of the generate button while the AI is working.

confirmOverwrite.message: The text field already contains text. Replace it with a generated alt text?
confirmOverwrite.description: Confirmation before an existing alt text is overwritten.

infoButtonLabel.description: Tooltip and accessible label of the info button next to the generate button.

infoProvider.description: Info popup row label: AI provider.

infoModel.description: Info popup row label: configured model.

infoLanguage.description: Info popup row label: language of the alt text.

infoLanguageAuto.description: Info popup: language setting is Automatic; the placeholder is the language that would be used for this post.

infoLastHeading.description: Heading in the info popup for details of the last request.

infoNoRequest.message: No alt text generated since the browser was started.
infoNoRequest.description: Info popup: no request was made yet.

infoTime.description: Info popup row label: time of the last request.

infoResult.description: Info popup row label: error of the last request.

infoModelUsed.description: Info popup row label: model ID reported in the response, if it differs from the configured one.

infoUpstream.description: Info popup row label: upstream provider that served an OpenRouter request.

infoDuration.description: Info popup row label: duration of the request.

infoInputTokens.description: Info popup row label: tokens sent (image and prompt).

infoOutputTokens.description: Info popup row label: tokens generated.

infoOutputWithReasoning.description: Output tokens including hidden reasoning tokens.

infoCost.description: Info popup row label: cost reported by the provider.

infoImage.description: Info popup row label: dimensions of the image sent to the provider.

infoLength.description: Info popup row label: length of the generated alt text.

infoOpenSettings.description: Link in the info popup that opens the Fediscribe settings.

errorMissingApiKey.message: No API key is set for the selected AI provider. Enter it in the Fediscribe settings.
errorMissingApiKey.description: Error: the API key is missing.

errorMissingModel.message: No model is selected for the selected AI provider. Choose one in the Fediscribe settings.

errorAuth.message: The AI provider rejected the request (API key or access rights): $DETAIL$
errorAuth.description: Error: HTTP 401/403 from the AI provider. The placeholder is the provider's own message.

errorRateLimit.message: The AI provider reports too many requests or an exhausted quota: $DETAIL$
errorRateLimit.description: Error: HTTP 429 from the AI provider.

errorApi.message: The AI provider reported an error (HTTP $STATUS$): $DETAIL$
errorApi.description: Error: other HTTP error from the AI provider.

errorNetwork.description: Error: the request could not be sent (offline, DNS, blocked).

errorTimeout.message: The AI provider did not answer in time. Try again, choose a faster model or increase the timeout in the settings.

errorEmptyResponse.message: The AI provider returned no text ($DETAIL$).
errorEmptyResponse.description: Error: the response contained no text. The placeholder is a technical reason, e.g. a finish reason.

errorBlocked.message: The AI provider refused to describe this image ($DETAIL$).
errorBlocked.description: Error: the request was blocked by the provider's content filter.

errorImageNotFound.message: No image was found in the dialog.
errorImageNotFound.description: Error: the image to describe could not be found.

errorImageFetch.message: The image could not be loaded: $DETAIL$

errorImagePermission.message: Fediscribe has no access to the media server $DETAIL$. Add it to this Mastodon server in the Fediscribe settings.
errorImagePermission.description: Error: missing permission for the media server. The placeholder is a host name.

errorImageUnsupported.description: Error: the image format is not supported or the image is too large.

errorExtensionUnavailable.message: Fediscribe is not reachable, probably because it was updated or reloaded. Reload this page and try again. ($DETAIL$)
errorExtensionUnavailable.description: Error: the background script did not answer.

errorNotMastodon.message: This does not seem to be a Mastodon server ($DETAIL$).
errorNotMastodon.description: Error when adding a server that is not a Mastodon server.

settingsSaved.description: Short confirmation that a setting was saved.

apiPermissionsMissing.message: Fediscribe needs permission to contact the AI providers' servers.
apiPermissionsMissing.description: Notice on the settings page when the permissions for the AI provider hosts are missing.

apiPermissionsGrant.description: Button that requests the permissions for the AI provider hosts.

serversHint.message: Fediscribe only runs on the servers listed here. Many servers deliver images from a separate media server; it is detected automatically and needs access as well.

serversEmpty.description: Shown when the server list is empty.

serverDomainLabel.description: Label of the input for the Mastodon server to add.

serverDomainPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the server domain input.

serverDomainHint.message: Choose one of the most active servers from the joinmastodon.org directory or enter any Mastodon server. It is checked automatically.
serverDomainHint.description: Hint below the server input with the drop-down list of popular servers.

serverInvalidDomain.message: Please enter a valid domain, e.g. mastodon.social.
serverInvalidDomain.description: Error for an invalid server domain.

serverFound.description: Result of a successful server check.

serverMediaLabel.description: Label of the media server input.

serverMediaPlaceholder.message: Host names, e.g. files.mastodon.social (leave empty if images come from the server itself)
serverMediaPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the media server input.

serverMediaHint.message: Separate several hosts with spaces. Fediscribe will ask for permission to access the server and these hosts.
serverMediaHint.description: Hint below the media server input.

serverMediaDetected.message: Media server detected. Check the list below and add the server.
serverMediaDetected.description: Status after a media server was detected.

serverMediaNotDetected.message: No separate media server detected. If the server's images come from another host, enter it here.
serverMediaNotDetected.description: Status when no media server was detected.

serverInvalidMedia.description: Error for invalid media host names.

serverAddButton.description: Button that adds the checked server and requests the permissions.

serverPermissionDenied.message: Permission was not granted; the server was not added.
serverPermissionDenied.description: Error when the user declines the permission request.

serverAdded.message: $DOMAIN$ added. Reload open tabs of this server to activate Fediscribe there.
serverAdded.description: Confirmation after a server was added.

serverRemoved.description: Confirmation after a server was removed.

serverMediaHosts.description: List of media servers of a configured server.

serverNoMediaHosts.description: Shown for a server without a media server.

serverPermissionMissing.message: Access permission missing; Fediscribe is inactive on this server.
serverPermissionMissing.description: Warning for a server whose permission is missing.

serverGrantButton.description: Button that requests the missing permission for a server.

providerGemini.description: Name of the provider Google Gemini.

apiKeyLabel.description: Label of the API key input.

apiKeyShow.description: Checkbox that shows the API key in plain text.

apiKeyHint.message: Stored only locally in this browser and sent only to the selected provider.
apiKeyHint.description: Hint below the API key input.

modelListLabel.description: Accessible label of the model list.

modelsReloadButton.description: Button that reloads the model list from the provider.

modelPlaceholder.message: Search, e.g. "flash lite", or enter a model ID
modelPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the searchable model field.

modelHint.message: The list is loaded from the provider; type to search model IDs and names. You can also enter any model ID; the model must accept images.

modelsNeedKey.message: Enter an API key to load the model list.
modelsNeedKey.description: Status when no API key is set.

modelsLoading.description: Status while the model list is loaded.

modelsLoaded.description: Status after the model list was loaded.

modelsNoMatch.message: No matching model. The text you entered is used as the model ID.
modelsNoMatch.description: Shown in the model drop-down when the search matches nothing.

testConnectionButton.description: Button that sends a test image to the provider.

testRunning.description: Status while the connection test runs.

testSuccess.message: Connection works. Description of the test image: $TEXT$
testSuccess.description: Result of a successful connection test.

text.example: A tree on a green meadow under a blue sky with a yellow sun.

languageAuto.description: Language option: detect the language automatically (post language, otherwise Mastodon interface language, otherwise English).

languageHint.message: Automatic uses the language selected for the post, otherwise the language of the Mastodon interface, otherwise English.
languageHint.description: Hint below the language selection explaining the "Automatic" option.

debugLabel.description: Checkbox that enables detailed console logging.

debugHint.message: Writes detailed messages with the prefix [Fediscribe] to the browser console. Info messages and errors are always logged.
